cx.parse: Output is JSON possibly followed by extra data: decode only the first object (json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode). Use models[] with visibility != 'hide'; order by priority ascending; supported_reasoning_levels lists valid efforts.

ag.parse: Skip the 'Fetching available models...' line; each following line is '<slug><TAB><label>'. Slug is the model id; the -low/-medium/-high suffix is the effort.

cc.parse: No model-list command. 'claude --help' only shows aliases (fable, opus, sonnet). Use the newest full model ids known to the assistant/vendor docs and confirm each with one minimal live ping.

tier_rules: standard = cheap/fast triage (cc: haiku, cx: *-luna low, ag: newest flash low).
effort = daily driver (cc: newest sonnet high, cx: newest *-sol medium, ag: newest flash medium).
deepthink = deliberate escalation (cc: newest opus high, cx: newest *-sol xhigh, ag: claude-sonnet-5-5 high while gemini pro absent).
ag.argon = explicit gemini-4-argon-medium alternative on A-7D; standard/effort/deepthink remain unchanged.
max/ultra efforts are explicit per-call overrides, never a default tier.
Never pick models with visibility 'hide'. Keep an effort only if the model lists it as supported.
instructions: 1. Run each sources[*].command (skip a peer whose CLI is absent) and read versions with '<cli> --version'.

2. Compare the CLI output with the effective profiles ('peerhub profile list') using tier_rules; present a diff of proposed changes to the user and wait for approval. Observations are evidence, not policy: never change packaged defaults without approval.

3. After approval edit the packaged peerhub/config_data/model-defaults.toml, the only store of profiles, exact_model_pools, observed_at, observed_versions and defaults_revision (new revision YYYY-MM-DD.N). Adding, changing or deleting a profile is one [profiles."<peer>.<name>"] table (plus an exact_model_pools entry for a new model). Rewrite each touched profile 'source' as 'cli:<sources command>@<observed version> <observed_at>' (cc: 'known-id:claude --help aliases@<version> <observed_at>'). Review the linked adapter docs for invocation or version changes. Keep files LF.
4. Run: python -m pytest -q tests/communication/adapters (test_model_profiles_manifest.py checks the toml invariants and this recipe against the documentation links).

5. Optional, ask first (uses a little quota): python -m tools.model_ping [profile_id ...] pings each effective profile once (workspace/global opt-ins included) and checks WHICH model answered (cc: modelUsage, cx: session log, ag: CLI log). Report failures verbatim.
6. Do not commit, push or release unless the user asks. Answer the user in their language; keep internal text English. Record dated observations in CHANGELOG.md, not here.
